title: Project Coordination Retention on Network and Server Deposit Credits
content:
The coordination retention of a deposit credit, the Hardware Procurement deposit credit that returns the paid deposit of a Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order cancelled after its purchase order, follows the client's in-progress Professional Services Projects engagements, the largest class among them deciding:

- **60.00 USD** when the client holds no in-progress engagement;
- **30.00 USD** when every in-progress engagement is classed Assessment Engagement or Quick Start Project;
- **nothing** when any in-progress engagement is classed Standard Project, Advanced Project, Major Project or Strategic Program.

The retention is retained from the deposit credit. Class and status are read from the client's project engagement records; only engagements whose status is in progress count.

| In-progress engagements | Coordination retention |
|---|---|
| none | 60.00 |
| one Assessment Engagement | 30.00 |
| one Quick Start Project and one Assessment Engagement | 30.00 |
| one Quick Start Project and one Advanced Project | nothing |
| one Strategic Program | nothing |
